newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KALNAPILIS SALES UP IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: KALNAPILIS SALES UP IN MARCH.

text.p: LIthuania's Kalnapilis brewery said on Friday that its sales rose in March to 200,000 decalitres of beer versus 170,000 litres in February.

"Our sales grew in March and were 200,000 decalitres in March compared with 170,000 decalitres a month ago and more than dubble the March 1996 firgure," the director of the company, Lionginas Mackevichius, told Reuters.
Mackevichius also said that the sales of the company in January 1997 were 174,000 decalitres.
Mackevichius added that its share of the country's beer market was 23.06 percent.
"Our strategic aim is to become the leader of the local beer market," Mackevichius said.
The biggest stake of the market was grabbed by Utenos Beverages which had 27 percent in March.
Mackevichius said that the company's first quarter results would be announced in the second half of April.
